By registering, authorizing, or using GoToFlow, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described below and in our Privacy Policy.

Data Controller

  • Andrey Cherenok, Individual Entrepreneur

1. Categories of Data We Process

  • Email address and name, if provided.
  • Authentication identifiers from third-party login providers (e.g., Google, Telegram).
  • IP address, browser type, device information, and operating system.
  • Cookies, session data, and technical usage information.
  • Activity within the Service, feature usage, and timestamps.
  • Payment and subscription metadata (transaction status, billing period, plan type).
  • Prompts, topics, links, uploaded materials, and AI-generated outputs created through the Service.
  • Support communications, feedback, and other data you voluntarily provide.

2. Purposes of Processing

  • Register and authenticate users; provide access to the Service and its features.
  • Manage accounts, subscriptions, and token balances; process payments.
  • Process user inputs through AI systems to generate content and deliver the Service's core functionality.
  • Provide customer support; respond to inquiries and feedback.
  • Maintain security; detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and unauthorized access.
  • Analyze usage to improve the Service's performance, reliability, and user experience.
  • Send transactional and service-related communications.
  • Send marketing communications where you have given consent or where otherwise permitted by applicable law.

3. Processing Methods

  • Personal data may be processed with or without automated means, including collection, storage, use, transfer, analysis, anonymization, deletion, and destruction.
  • Content data (prompts, inputs, outputs) may be processed by third-party AI infrastructure providers to deliver the Service's AI features.

4. Third-Party Recipients

  • Your data may be shared with third-party providers where necessary for the operation of the Service, including:
  • Hosting and cloud infrastructure providers.
  • AI infrastructure providers (for content generation).
  • Payment processors (for transactions and subscriptions).
  • Analytics tools (for usage measurement and product improvement).
  • Authentication providers (for third-party login).
  • Support tools (for customer communications).
  • Legal or governmental authorities where required by applicable law.

5. International Transfers

  • Where necessary for the operation of the Service, your personal data may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your country of residence.
  • We apply appropriate safeguards where required by applicable law.

6. Retention

  • Your data is retained for the duration of your use of the Service.
  • After account deletion, data may be retained as required by applicable law, for accounting purposes, or to resolve disputes.

7. Withdrawal of Consent

  • You may withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us at: gotoflow.io@gmail.com.
  • Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal.
  • Withdrawal may limit or prevent continued use of certain features of the Service.

8. Your Confirmation

  • By using the Service, you confirm that:
  • You act voluntarily and of your own accord.
  • The data you provide is accurate and up to date.
  • You understand the scope and purposes of this consent.
  • You have reviewed the Privacy Policy available at https://gotoflow.io/privacy-policy.

Contact
